propositions: Eight pytest-invoking CI lanes (six in external-integration.yml, two discovered in _eval-discipline.yml and _optionality.yml) lack per-test hang guards, allowing deadlocked tests to hide behind final dots with no traceback or timeout
Pytest hang guards --timeout and --timeout-method=thread exist only in _build-and-test.yml's shared suite, while other lanes run under GitHub's 360-minute job default with no per-test budget
Per-test timeout budgets must be calibrated per-lane from historical runtime data (reading Actions step durations) using the rule: minimum 10x observed mean per-test duration, floored at 300s

Detection rule for anti-regression parity assertion must exhaustively match all four pytest invocation forms (bare pytest, pytest -m, python -m pytest, path-prefixed python) while rejecting non-invoking text (pip install arguments, shell comments)
Each guarded lane requires both --timeout and --timeout-method=thread flags with per-lane budget and evidence documented as YAML comments at the step
